basic_info.description: Rare opportunity to buy a home thats been in one family for 115 years! Classic Victorian with Modern Potential in Bernal Heights Opportunity. Step back in time and embrace the charm of this Victorian home, built in 1904 and nestled in the heart of desirable Bernal Heights. This 3 bedroom, 1 full bath, 2 half bath home, encompassing 1,675 sq ft of living space, is ready for you to create your dream home. The spacious layout provides a wonderful canvas for your vision. Imagine the possibilities within these walls, waiting to be reimagined and personalized to your taste. A rare find in the city, this property boasts a large lot of 2,750 sq ft, offering ample space for outdoor enjoyment. A convenient 1 car garage, cleverly designed to fit two cars tandem, completes this exceptional offering. Easy access to 101. Walking distance to both Precita Park and Bernal Heights Park. Don't miss this opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history and create a future filled with Victorian elegance and modern comfort!
